# NewsBot Python dependencies
#
# Pinning strategy
# ----------------
# This file lists MINIMUM acceptable versions (>= constraints).
# Exact pins live in requirements.lock, generated by pip-tools:
#
#   pip install pip-tools
#   pip-compile requirements.txt -o requirements.lock
#   pip install -r requirements.lock     # deploy / CI
#
# To upgrade all deps to latest compatible:
#   pip-compile --upgrade requirements.txt -o requirements.lock
#
# Python version note
# -------------------
# torch>=2.9.0 is required for Python 3.14+ support.
# torch 2.6.x and earlier have no wheels for Python 3.14.
# See: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/releases
#
# Never pip install -r requirements.txt directly in production.
# Always use requirements.lock.

# --- Core pipeline ---
feedparser>=6.0.11
httpx>=0.28.1
trafilatura>=2.0.0
sentence-transformers>=3.4.1
torch>=2.9.0
numpy>=2.0.0

# --- NLP / parsing ---
spacy>=3.8.0
vaderSentiment>=3.3.2
python-dateutil>=2.9.0

# --- Scraping ---
# beautifulsoup4 provides the `bs4` package used in ingestion/scraper.py,
# ingestion/article_fetcher.py, and bias/source_ratings.py.
# lxml is used as the BeautifulSoup parser backend ("lxml" parser string).
beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0
lxml>=5.0.0
# playwright drives a headless Chromium browser to bypass Cloudflare WAF on
# allsides.com. After pip install, run: playwright install chromium
playwright>=1.44.0

# --- Config / env ---
pyyaml>=6.0.2
python-dotenv>=1.0.0

# --- Scheduling ---
apscheduler>=3.10.0

# --- Delivery ---
# resend is the transactional email SDK used in delivery/email_sender.py.
resend>=2.0.0

# --- Dev / tooling (not installed in production) ---
# pip-tools>=7.4        # pip-compile for lock file generation
# pytest>=8.3           # test runner
